why: A write per iteration is a round trip per iteration. Collect the ops and run one bulkWrite, or update one document with arrayFilters.
good: await scope.workorders.bulkWrite(steps.map((s) => ({ updateOne: { filter: { number }, update: { $set: { 'plan.$[s].status': 'done' } }, arrayFilters: [{ 's.qid': s.qid }] } })));
